Name: Doves and Pigeons
Author: omena007
Description:
I didn't realise my farm needed pigeons before I saw Rangerkatt's amazing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2513]Pigeons and Doves Mod.[/url] So I made this non-replacer version with their permission. This mod adds 6 types of pigeons as farm animals: regular pigeon, white dove, mourning dove, pioneer pigeon, racing pigeon and modena pigeon. They cost 5000g each and need a deluxe coop. They only lay (a lot of) small pigeon eggs, but there's a catch! One type of pigeon can bring you a valuable surprise gift when you achieve high enough friendship with them. *New* now pigeons leave you droppings that you can turn into fertilizer by using recycle machine (3 needed).

For the new surprise item:

[spoiler]

[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/6ad14e59fa66af9c5cc16f720fa49c48/2ff3d79eb6e68a94-41/s75x75_c1/c40a4f926108adc905d7b2c0dcf46ab76de7697f.png[/img]
"The olive branch is an ancient symbol of peace. It will defend you agains even the most aggressive foes."
(Only!) White Doves can bring you an Olive Branch. It's a consumable item that grants you +10 defense and +5 luck for 420 game minutes.
[/spoiler]
